title: test(verify): the two untimed requires-knowledge cases take the file's 120_000 budget
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg3zXREECfPtgrM8TPQaxn1v)_

Fixes #37700
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户无感:只改了一份内部测试的等待上限,产品行为前后不变。
- 为什么做:知识库能力的一条新测试在主干定时全量构建里超时,把主干标红;本改动让它在繁忙的构建机上也有足够时间。
- 出错会怎样:最坏只是这条测试仍偶发超时,主干再红一次,可直接撤回,不影响任何用户。
- 要你做什么:无。

## What changes

`packages/verify/src/harness.required-providers.test.ts` only. The two cases in the `requires: ['knowledge']` describe that still ran on vitest's 5000 ms default now take the file's per-case `120_000`, which every other boot/import case in the file already carries. Each carries a comment with its measurement:

- **an install without the optional libSQL store** (the failing case). It clears the module cache (`vi.resetModules()`) and `constructServedProviders` then re-imports the provider graph. Local: 1138 / 1358 / 1365 ms over three runs. The scheduled run 45888214247 (job 140145134703, Test Core 10/10) read this file's tests at 57.8 s, which is 52.8 s outside this case against 16.2 s locally, so 3.3x. 1365 ms x 3.3 = 4.5 s, which leaves no margin under 5000 ms. The case was killed at 5000 ms.
- **a host that mounts the service itself**. The same `constructServedProviders` shape, and it had no timeout either. 111-114 ms in file order, 431 ms alone on a cold cache (`-t`). x 3.3 = 1.4 s cold. It is not failing today; it gets the same budget so the risk is covered the same way.

The other three knowledge cases already carry `120_000`. I chose a per-case timeout over a shared boot (the #28631 shape) because the slow case is not a repeated boot. Its cost is a module re-import that it causes on purpose, and nothing could share it. The file's own convention is a per-case `120_000`. Nothing is skipped.

## Tests

<details><summary>File run on the final head, plus three earlier measurement runs</summary>

```
head fdf439c4e: pnpm --filter @objectstack/verify exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 --reporter=verbose src/harness.required-providers.test.ts
 ✓ ... a host that mounts the service itself keeps its own, and the runtime adds no store 235ms
 ✓ ... an install without the optional libSQL store: ... says so once 1487ms
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  15 passed (15)
os-verify-lock: VERDICT command-exit 0

measurement runs (base 9476092c7, verbose): libSQL case 1138 / 1358 / 1365 ms; host case 114 / 113 / 111 ms;
file tests 17.44 / 17.19 / 17.55 s; host case alone (-t) 431 ms
pnpm --filter @objectstack/verify typecheck  -> VERDICT command-exit 0 (check:test-typecheck: OK, the test layer compiles)
```
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- `overlap-check`: `#37676 (shares packages/verify/src/harness.required-providers.test.ts): merges cleanly`, `VERDICT clean exit 0`. The overlap is textual only.
- The file's `test-budget: 28` header is out of date. The CI run above read the file at 57.8 s (including the 5 s timeout), and its own text says "the first CI reading after the knowledge boots re-measures it". This PR does not re-set the budget, because that is outside the card's acceptance. Noted here for the lane.
- No changeset. The diff is a `*.test.ts` under `src/`. `@objectstack/verify` ships `dist`, `README.md` and `CHANGELOG.md`. After `pnpm --filter @objectstack/verify build`, grepping `dist` finds 0 hits for the case title, and the positive control `bootStack` is found (`dist/index.js`, `dist/index.cjs`). The PR carries `skip-changeset`.

## Verification

Read first: the one hunk at the end of the knowledge describe (the libSQL case's closing `}, 120_000);` and its comment).

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/verify exec vitest run --reporter=verbose src/harness.required-providers.test.ts` should print 15 passed, with the libSQL case at about 1-1.5 s locally. The real proof is the next scheduled full run going green on Test Core 10/10.
